title: The Bitcoin vs. Nasdaq Signal Has Flipped Bullish
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine The Bitcoin vs. Nasdaq Signal Has Flipped Bullish As tech drops, Bitcoin holds. Sean Hagan examines the BTC/Nasdaq ratio reclaiming its 200-day MA, historical 84% median gains, and his $100K line in the sand. This post The Bitcoin vs. Nasdaq Signal Has Flipped Bullish first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
